scope: reason-level diagnostic projection of the immutable 24-case historical baseline

independent_judgment_invalid.basis: The historical public ledger records only a rejected judgment envelope and no bounded judgment diagnostic. It cannot honestly distinguish a citation failure from another protocol failure.

independent_model_unavailable.basis: The independent scoring endpoint did not return an eligible usable model result.

task_timeout.basis: The task exceeded its recorded execution deadline.

limitations: This is a projection of an existing public evidence ledger, not a rerun.
The old ledger has no per-case judgment_diagnostic field, so its seven independent_judgment_invalid cases cannot be split between CITATION and other MODEL_PROTOCOL causes without guessing.
Zero counts mean no explicit machine evidence in this ledger, not proof that the failure class cannot occur.
